subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: When status-card rendering is disabled, what exact contract should chat `/status` and `session_status` provide: no visible card, a concise text reply, or a supported structured result?
rationale: This choice defines a new public configuration and output contract across two callers; source inspection cannot determine the intended user experience or durable API shape.

options.title: Add one opt-in suppression mode
options.body: Keep current rendering as the default and add one documented mode with explicitly defined fallback text or result semantics for both paths.

options.title: Design separate chat and tool contracts
options.body: Allow chat presentation suppression while separately specifying a stable structured `session_status` result, accepting a larger API surface.

options.title: Decline the configuration surface
options.body: Retain the current always-rendered status response and document the existing CLI JSON diagnostics path as separate from conversation status.

recommendation.title: Add one opt-in suppression mode
recommendation.body: Keep current rendering as the default and add one documented mode with explicitly defined fallback text or result semantics for both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commit and discussion history connect steipete to both the shared status path and the decision to retain this issue as the canonical tracker.
